title: Netlify Personal access token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 characters vs the provider-documented 40 (answers.netlify.com: "increase capacity for the token to 40 characters"). Twin of "Netlify Personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of netlify-token-pat-shape-bare: length: 39 characters vs the provider-documented 40 (answers.netlify.com: "increase capacity for the token to 40 characters"). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
